38	      { "block_id": "block_04", "block_type": "person (before)", "position": "center of the left panel", "visual_function": "Shows the problem: tried everything, no change", "adaptation_rule": "3D cartoon woman with a short sleek black bob haircut, tight red mini dress, standing in full side profile facing right, head slightly down, tired disappointed face, flat glutes, straight hips, thin legs", "present_in_reference": true },

44	      { "block_id": "block_10", "block_type": "handwritten notes with hearts (after side)", "position": "right-middle of the right panel, between the AFTER character and the product", "visual_function": "Positive feelings of the after", "adaptation_rule": "White marker handwriting with small outline hearts", "present_in_reference": true },

47	      { "block_id": "block_13", "block_type": "icon row", "position": "bottom of the right panel, centered", "visual_function": "Three quick reasons to trust", "adaptation_rule": "Three thin-line white icons (a leaf, a capsule, a heart outline) each with a short white label", "present_in_reference": true }
48	    ],

53	      "Prices, discount labels, CTA buttons or offer boxes",

59	  "visual_prompt": "Square 1:1 before/after ad in a glossy stylized 3D animated cartoon style, recreating the exact composition of the attached reference ad but with a different product, brand colors, character and texts. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product: do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. The product is a matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern, and a solid hot-pink band wrapping the bottom fifth of the bottle; its black label shows a small pink VITALABH emblem, a huge bold white 'AGUAJE', the line 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' ('3 EN 1' in pink-red), a thin hot-pink banner, a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a swoosh, three small pink-outlined boxes with '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO', '200mg MACA NEGRA', and '60 CÁPSULAS' at the bottom. LAYOUT: vertical split screen. LEFT PANEL (about 38% of the width): deep plum-black background #2A0E22 with a soft dark vignette, dim and desaturated. At the top center of this panel, a small rounded pill in muted dark plum with the white word 'ANTES'. In the top-left corner, a small white hand-drawn scribble doodle. In the middle of the panel stands the BEFORE character: a young Latina woman rendered as a 3D cartoon with a short sleek jet-black bob haircut, wearing a tight red mini dress, standing in full side profile facing right, head slightly lowered with a tired, disappointed expression; her silhouette is flat: flat glutes with no projection, straight hips and thin legs; framed from head to just below the knees. Down the left edge of this panel, three white handwritten notes stacked vertically, the first one with a small curved hand-drawn arrow pointing to her. A thick white curved arrow starts in the left panel at chest height and arcs into the right panel, pointing at the AFTER character's hip. RIGHT PANEL (about 62% of the width): vivid hot fuchsia background #E6177F glowing to bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 in the center and deep magenta #B0105E at the edges, with scattered white four-point sparkles and a few small white outline hearts. At the top left of this panel, a small rounded light-pink pill with the white word 'DESPUÉS'. Standing at the left-center of the right panel, slightly overlapping the split line, the AFTER character: the SAME woman with the same black bob and the same tight red dress, the same full side profile facing right, now chin up with a calm confident smile; the change must be obvious at first glance in the profile silhouette: visibly fuller, rounder and lifted glutes with clear projection, curvier hips and thicker toned thighs, the red dress hugging her curves, natural and tasteful (not vulgar). In the top right of the right panel, a large left-aligned 4-line headline (white and yellow lines, ultra-heavy sans-serif caps with a soft dark drop shadow) and directly under it a 3-line white subtitle in a clean rounded sans-serif. On the right-middle, between the AFTER character and the product, three white handwritten notes stacked vertically, each accompanied by a small hand-drawn outline heart. In the bottom-right corner, the real product bottle, large (about 35% of the image height), upright, sharp and fully readable, with a large soft pink flower with glowing petals behind it at the right edge and a soft shadow at its base. At the bottom center, around the split line under the characters' legs, a round black seal with a thick metallic gold rim, three small gold stars along its top, a small gold shield with a check on its left edge, a big gold word and a smaller white line inside. Along the bottom of the right panel, centered between the seal and the product, a row of three thin-line white icons (a leaf, a capsule, a heart outline), each with a small white label underneath. Clean backgrounds, no noise, everything readable on a phone. Do not add other bottles, calendars, CTA buttons, price badges, benefit lists, extra icons, extra badges, rating stars, bottom bars, discount labels, testimonials, logos or any text not listed.",

61	    { "block_id": "text_block_01", "reference_function": "badge (before label)", "reference_position": "top center of the left panel, inside a rounded pill", "text_style": "Bold sans-serif caps, white, small, inside a muted dark plum pill", "text": "ANTES" },

63	    { "block_id": "text_block_03", "reference_function": "main headline (lines 1-2)", "reference_position": "top right of the right panel, first two lines of the headline block", "text_style": "Ultra-heavy geometric sans-serif, ALL CAPS, left-aligned, very tight leading, soft dark drop shadow. 65	    { "block_id": "text_block_05", "reference_function": "subtitle", "reference_position": "right panel, directly under the headline, left-aligned", "text_style": "Clean rounded sans-serif (Poppins Medium look), white, sentence case, about 3 lines, much smaller than the headline", "text": "Su plan de 3 meses: 2 cápsulas al día, con su comida y su rutina." },
66	    { "block_id": "text_block_06", "reference_function": "handwritten note (before 1)", "reference_position": "left edge of the left panel, upper third, with a small arrow to the character", "text_style": "Casual white marker handwriting, two lines", "text": "Pastillas sin resultado" },
67	    { "block_id": "text_block_07", "reference_function": "handwritten note (before 2)", "reference_position": "left edge of the left panel, middle", "text_style": "Casual white marker handwriting, two lines", "text": "Plata perdida" },
68	    { "block_id": "text_block_08", "reference_function": "handwritten note (before 3)", "reference_position": "left edge of the left panel, lower third", "text_style": "Casual white marker handwriting, two lines", "text": "Sin constancia" },
69	    { "block_id": "text_block_09", "reference_function": "handwritten note (after 1)", "reference_position": "right-middle of the right panel, top of the notes stack, with a small outline heart", "text_style": "Casual white marker handwriting, two lines, small drawn heart", "text": "Un plan claro" },
70	    { "block_id": "text_block_10", "reference_function": "handwritten note (after 2)", "reference_position": "right-middle of the right panel, middle of the notes stack, with a small outline heart", "text_style": "Casual white marker handwriting, two lines, small drawn heart", "text": "Triple acción" },
71	    { "block_id": "text_block_11", "reference_function": "handwritten note (after 3)", "reference_position": "right-middle of the right panel, bottom of the notes stack, just above the product", "text_style": "Casual white marker handwriting, two lines", "text": "Por fin constante" },
72	    { "block_id": "text_block_12", "reference_function": "badge (seal)", "reference_position": "inside the round black-and-gold seal at the bottom center", "text_style": "'PAGAS' big in bold metallic gold caps; 'AL RECIBIR' below in smaller bold white caps; centered", "text": "PAGAS AL RECIBIR" },
73	    { "block_id": "text_block_13", "reference_function": "trust item (icon label 1)", "reference_position": "under the leaf icon, bottom row, left", "text_style": "Small regular sans-serif, white, sentence case, centered, two lines", "text": "Ingredientes de origen vegetal" },
74	    { "block_id": "text_block_14", "reference_function": "trust item (icon label 2)", "reference_position": "under the capsule icon, bottom row, center", "text_style": "Small regular sans-serif, white, sentence case, centered, two lines", "text": "2 cápsulas al día" },
75	    { "block_id": "text_block_15", "reference_function": "trust item (icon label 3)", "reference_position": "under the heart icon, bottom row, right", "text_style": "Small regular sans-serif, white, sentence case, centered", "text": "Sin cirugía" }
76	  ],
77	  "mandatory_visual_elements": [
78	    "Vertical split: dark plum-black left panel (~38%) and hot fuchsia right panel (~62%)",
79	    "The same 3D cartoon woman (black bob, tight red dress, side profile facing right) in both panels, with an obvious body change in the silhouette: flat in the before; fuller rounder glutes, curvier hips and thicker thighs in the after",
80	    "Thick white curved arrow from the before panel into the after panel",
81	    "White scribble doodle in the top-left corner and a small hand-drawn arrow from the first before note",
82	    "Small outline hearts next to the after notes, white four-point sparkles on the fuchsia panel",
83	    "The real AGUAJE COMPLEX 3 EN 1 bottle from the attached photo, large in the bottom-right corner, with a large soft pink flower behind it",
84	    "Round black seal with gold rim, three small gold stars and a small gold shield-check",
85	    "Row of three thin-line white icons: a leaf, a capsule and a heart outline"
86	  ],
87	  "final_generation_exclusions": [
88	    "No dropper bottle, no 'muna' or 'VITALDROPS' or any brand, logo or text from the reference ad",
89	    "No guarantee text, no '90 días'",
90	    "No other pill bottles, no calendars, no extra props",
91	    "Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.",
92	    "Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.",
93	    "Do not add CTA buttons, prices, badges, benefits, icons, trust seals, ratings, testimonials, bottom bars, discount labels, offer boxes or extra claims unless they are explicitly listed in detected_visual_blocks or text_layers.",
94	    "Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements."
95	  ],
96	  "meta_policy_check": "All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. No prohibited claims, no false guarantees and no direct personal attribute callouts (third person, never 'you').",
97	  "language_rule": "All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish, perfectly spelled, with accents.",
98	  "app_chat": {
99	    "cambio": "Chica de cabello corto tipo bob negro, vestido rojo ajustado, pose de perfil"
100	  }
